chapters.title: God has spoken by His Son
chapters.summary: God spoke through the prophets, but now by His Son, the radiance of His glory, who made purification for sins and sat down at God's right hand, far above the angels.

chapters.title: Made like His brothers
chapters.summary: Do not drift from so great a salvation. Jesus was made like us in every way so that He could die for us and help those who are tempted.

chapters.title: Greater than Moses
chapters.summary: Jesus is faithful over God's house as a Son. Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts as Israel did in the wilderness.

chapters.title: A Sabbath rest
chapters.summary: A rest remains for God's people. The word of God is living and sharper than any sword. Our high priest sympathizes with our weakness, so come boldly to the throne of grace.

chapters.title: A priest forever
chapters.summary: Christ did not appoint Himself high priest; God called Him, after the order of Melchizedek. He learned obedience through suffering.

chapters.title: An anchor for the soul
chapters.summary: Move on to maturity and do not fall away. God's promise and oath give us hope, an anchor for the soul, sure and steadfast.

chapters.title: Melchizedek
chapters.summary: Melchizedek was a priest-king greater than Abraham. Jesus is a priest forever, who always lives to intercede for those who come to God through Him.

chapters.title: A better covenant
chapters.summary: Jesus serves in the true heavenly sanctuary and mediates a better covenant, the new covenant promised through Jeremiah.

chapters.title: The blood of Christ
chapters.summary: The old tabernacle's sacrifices could not clear the conscience. Christ entered once for all with His own blood and secured eternal redemption.

chapters.title: Once for all
chapters.summary: Christ's single sacrifice made us holy once for all. Draw near with a true heart, hold fast your hope, and do not give up meeting together.

chapters.title: By faith
chapters.summary: Faith is the substance of things hoped for. By faith Abel, Noah, Abraham, Sarah, Moses, Rahab and many others trusted God and looked ahead to His promise.

chapters.title: Run with endurance
chapters.summary: Surrounded by a great cloud of witnesses, run the race looking to Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith. God disciplines those He loves.

chapters.title: Jesus the same forever
chapters.summary: Keep loving one another and show hospitality. Be content, for God has said, I will never leave you nor forsake you. Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever.
